title: Subject vocabulary sheet and timetable frame
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 1 (Subject vocabulary sheet and timetable frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 1: My school and my subjects. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: I study, I like
points: أَدْرُسُ العُلُومَ وَالتَّارِيخَ: I study science and history
لَا أُحِبُّ ...: I do not like ...

parts.text: أَدْرُسُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ (object). وَأُحِبُّهَا: 'and I like it' (ـهَا for a feminine noun). لِأَنَّهَا مُفِيدَةٌ.

questions.q: Say: I study Arabic and I like it because it is useful.
questions.a: أَدْرُسُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَأُحِبُّهَا لِأَنَّهَا مُفِيدَةٌ.

questions.q: Core: Write five sentences about the subjects you study, with likes and dislikes.
questions.a: For example: أَدْرُسُ ثَمَانِيَ مَوَادَّ. أُحِبُّ العُلُومَ. أُحِبُّ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ كَثِيرًا. لَا أُحِبُّ الجُغْرَافِيَا. مَادَّتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ الحَاسُوبُ.

questions.q: Extend: Add a reason to three sentences with لِأَنَّهُ or لِأَنَّهَا.
questions.a: For example: أُحِبُّ العُلُومَ لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعَةٌ.

questions.q: Stretch: Say which is your favourite subject: مَادَّتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ ... لِأَنَّ ...
questions.a: For example: مَادَّتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ التَّارِيخُ لِأَنَّ المُعَلِّمَ يَشْرَحُ جَيِّدًا.

questions.q: 'I like history because it is interesting':
questions.a: B) أُحِبُّ التَّارِيخَ لِأَنَّهُ مُمْتِعٌ. التَّارِيخ is masculine singular: لِأَنَّهُ مُمْتِعٌ.

questions.q: What does مَادَّة mean? A) subject B) school C) teacher
Big question: say what you study and one subject you like, with a reason.
questions.a: For example: أَدْرُسُ العُلُومَ وَأُحِبُّهَا لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعَةٌ.
